taxonomy.note: Accepted by current Kew/POWO and Flora of North America, but current distributions place it in Arkansas, Kansas, Missouri and Oklahoma rather than Texas. Older literature has sometimes extended it into Texas, creating a useful taxonomic/range-confusion lesson.

evidence: Kew/POWO currently lists the native range as Alabama, Arkansas, Kansas, Missouri and Oklahoma, with no Texas.
Flora of North America lists Callirhoe digitata from Arkansas, Kansas, Missouri and Oklahoma and describes it as an Ozark/Ouachita/Cherokee Plains species.
target_zone_range.blocking_issue: Current authoritative distribution does not include Texas.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Do not preserve legacy Texas-range claims as native evidence when current Kew/FNA treatments exclude Texas.

morphology.look_here_first: Think tall, glaucous perennial with highly dissected fingerlike leaves and NO involucellar bractlets. The inflorescence is paniculate, stipules are usually shed early, and the calyx lobes meet into a pointed bud.
diagnostic_traits: perennial from thickened root, usually erect rather than trailing
stems glaucous and nearly glabrous, commonly 0.5–2 m in FNA
leaves deeply 5–10-lobed with very narrow linear to lanceolate ultimate segments
stipules caducous, often absent by flowering
calyx lobes valvate in bud and form an apiculate/acuminate point
flowers reddish-purple, but color is not diagnostic
mericarps glabrous and indehiscent, beaks not prominent

confusers.separator: C. pedata is Texas-native, usually has persistent stipules and a racemose inflorescence; its leaves are 3–5-lobed rather than typically 5–10-lobed, though both can be strongly dissected.
C. leiocarpa is annual/biennial, with dehiscent mericarps and prominent beaks/collars; C. digitata is perennial with indehiscent fruit.
Winecup has 3 involucellar bractlets and a low trailing habit; C. digitata lacks the involucel and is tall/erect.

diagnostic_roles: deeply dissected leaf with narrow fingerlike segments
photo_verification.provenance_note: Use current-range references in the learner so older Texas-range claims do not silently re-enter the native pool.

installation_guardrail: Install only as an out-of-range/taxonomic comparison excluded from native metrics.
